authors: Jiaxiao Han; Youngseop Lee; Ziang Feng; Yue Wu; Zhuoying Wang; Allison Martinez Mejia; Adam Bauer; Manu Goyal; Jin-Moo Lee; Peinan Zhao; Hao F. Zhang; Cheng Sun; Song Hu

summary_en: This paper integrates two-photon microscopy with photoacoustic microscopy to image neuronal calcium activity and red-blood-cell oxygen release simultaneously at single-cell resolution in awake mice. A transparent optical micro-ring resonator serves as the ultrasound detector while preserving optical access, and dual-wavelength photoacoustic kymography quantifies oxygen dynamics. The system is a direct acoustic-optical image-formation contribution and a strong core addition.

summary_en: This paper develops an edge-aware short-chain diffusion method for reconstructing multispectral optoacoustic tomography from extremely sparse and noisy measurements. The contribution directly targets photoacoustic image formation and preserves structural fidelity under aggressive acquisition reduction, making it a strong core addition for computational optoacoustic reconstruction.
